description: This file contains unit tests for the LoadBalancerEncoder component in the QUIC protocol implementation, including test vectors, configuration updates, and edge case handling.

classes.name: LoadBalancerEncoderPeer
classes.description: Provides a static method to set the number of nonces left in the encoder for testing purposes.

classes.name: TestLoadBalancerEncoderVisitor
classes.description: Implements LoadBalancerEncoderVisitorInterface to track configuration add/delete events during tests.

classes.name: TestRandom
classes.description: Custom pseudo-random generator allowing predefined output for deterministic testing.

classes.name: LoadBalancerEncoderTest
classes.description: Test fixture class for LoadBalancerEncoder unit tests.

classes.name: LoadBalancerEncoderTestCase
classes.description: Struct representing test vectors with configuration, connection ID, and server ID.

methods.name: SetNumNoncesLeft
methods.description: Static method to set the number of nonces remaining in the encoder.

methods.name: ~TestLoadBalancerEncoderVisitor
methods.description: Destructor for the test visitor class.

methods.name: OnConfigAdded
methods.description: Callback invoked when a new configuration is added.

methods.name: OnConfigChanged
methods.description: Callback invoked when a configuration is changed.

methods.name: OnConfigDeleted
methods.description: Callback invoked when a configuration is deleted.

methods.name: Num_adds
methods.description: Returns the number of configuration additions.

methods.name: Num_deletes
methods.description: Returns the number of configuration deletions.

methods.name: RandUint64
methods.description: Returns a predefined 64-bit random value.

methods.name: RandBytes
methods.description: Fills a buffer with pseudo-random bytes.

methods.name: InsecureRandBytes
methods.description: Fills a buffer with pseudo-random bytes, same as RandBytes.

methods.name: InsecureRandUint64
methods.description: Returns a pseudo-random 64-bit value.

methods.name: AddNextValues
methods.description: Adds predefined high and low 64-bit values to the queue for deterministic output.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Factory method to create a LoadBalancerEncoder instance.

methods.name: CreateUnencrypted
methods.description: Creates an unencrypted load balancer configuration.

methods.name: UpdateConfig
methods.description: Updates the encoder with a new load balancer configuration.

methods.name: GenerateConnectionId
methods.description: Generates a new connection ID based on current configuration and nonces.

methods.name: IsEncoding
methods.description: Checks if the encoder is currently encoding.

methods.name: IsEncrypted
methods.description: Checks if the current configuration is encrypted.

methods.name: DeleteConfig
methods.description: Deletes the current load balancer configuration.

methods.name: MaybeReplaceConnectionId
methods.description: Possibly replaces a given connection ID based on current configuration.

methods.name: GenerateNextConnectionId
methods.description: Generates the next connection ID if configuration allows.

methods.name: ConnectionIdLength
methods.description: Returns the length of connection IDs for a given config ID.

methods.name: Create
methods.description: Creates a LoadBalancerServerId from a byte array.
